name: race
description: Ancestries with culture, appearance, and suggested traits

fields.Name: Human
fields.Description: Adaptable people found across nearly every region, with highly varied appearances, cultures, and traditions.

fields.Name: Elf
fields.Description: Long-lived, sharp-featured people known for keen senses, graceful movement, and cultures deeply tied to magic or nature.

fields.Name: Dwarf
fields.Description: Compact, sturdy people renowned for endurance, craftsmanship, clan traditions, and settlements carved into stone.

fields.Name: Halfling
fields.Description: Small, nimble people who value community, comfort, curiosity, and the courage to protect their homes.

fields.Name: Orc
fields.Description: Powerfully built people with prominent tusks and diverse cultures that often prize resilience, honor, and collective strength.

fields.Name: Goblin
fields.Description: Small, quick people with expressive features, sharp senses, and a talent for improvisation, trade, and inventive tools.

fields.Name: Ashborn
fields.Description: Charcoal-skinned descendants of wildfire spirits who build migratory glass cities.

fields.Name: Tidekin
fields.Description: Amphibious people with translucent fins whose floating clans follow moon-driven currents.

fields.Name: Stonehearts
fields.Description: Broad, mineral-skinned artisans who preserve memories in carved family pillars.

fields.Name: Mothfolk
fields.Description: Nocturnal, velvet-winged scholars drawn to light and forgotten knowledge.

fields.Name: Thornbloods
fields.Description: Plantlike wanderers who bloom according to emotion and exchange stories as seeds.

fields.Name: Cloudstriders
fields.Description: Tall, hollow-boned nomads from mountain bridges who read weather as language.

fields.Name: Mirrorborn
fields.Description: Reflective-eyed people whose appearance subtly echoes whoever stands nearby.

fields.Name: Ember Dwarves
fields.Description: Compact volcanic smiths who treat every crafted object as a temporary ancestor.

fields.Name: Hush Elves
fields.Description: Pale forest dwellers who cultivate silence and communicate with hand signs while hunting.

fields.Name: Burrowlings
fields.Description: Rabbit-eared communal farmers famous for emergency tunnels and alarming hospitality.

fields.Name: Coralbound
fields.Description: Living reef people who add colorful fragments throughout life and host tiny symbiotic creatures.

fields.Name: Clocklings
fields.Description: Small constructed beings awakened when a master clock broke, each searching for a personal purpose.

fields.Name: Dreamscarred
fields.Description: Humanoids altered by a shared ancestral nightmare, bearing moving birthmarks.

fields.Name: Frostmanes
fields.Description: Fur-covered northern clans whose songs encode maps across shifting ice.

fields.Name: Glimmer Goblins
fields.Description: Curious tunnel traders with luminous freckles and a culture built around clever reuse.

fields.Name: Marshscale
fields.Description: Patient reptilian fishers who elect leaders through week-long debates.

fields.Name: Ravenfolk
fields.Description: Feathered collectors of promises who consider exact memory a sacred duty.

fields.Name: Ironveined
fields.Description: Former humans transformed by magical mines, with metal threading their skin.

fields.Name: Dusk Giants
fields.Description: Gentle seven-foot nomads whose size diminishes in bright daylight.

fields.Name: Lantern Souls
fields.Description: Spirits housed in crafted bodies, with visible inner lights changing color by mood.

fields.Name: Fungal Kin
fields.Description: Colony beings grown around a shared core, trading memories through spores.

fields.Name: Sandshapers
fields.Description: Desert people with flowing features who record history in glass sculptures.

fields.Name: Wolven
fields.Description: Pack-oriented hunters who settle disputes through ritual races instead of violence.

fields.Name: Starfallen
fields.Description: Rare luminous travelers descended from something that crashed centuries ago.

fields.Name: River Orcs
fields.Description: Powerful boat-building clans who value rescue, hospitality, and competitive poetry.

fields.Name: Echoes
fields.Description: Humanoids born in ancient ruins who occasionally repeat words spoken there long ago.

fields.Name: Waxfolk
fields.Description: Sculptable people created by forgotten artisans who renew their features during festivals.

fields.Name: Rooted
fields.Description: Bark-skinned guardians able to stand still for days while listening through soil.

fields.Name: Moonclaws
fields.Description: Feline cliff-city inhabitants with ritualized curiosity and elaborate family debts.

fields.Name: Patchwork Folk
fields.Description: Descendants of magically fused refugees whose varied bodies celebrate adaptation.
